business_policies_effective_interval_che.name: business_policies_effective_interval_check
business_policies_effective_interval_che.value:
"business_policies"."effective_to" is null
        or ("business_policies"."effective_from" is not null and "business_policies"."effective_to" > "business_policies"."effective_from")

business_policies_publication_check.name: business_policies_publication_check
business_policies_publication_check.value:
"business_policies"."status" = 'draft'
        or ("business_policies"."effective_from" is not null and "business_policies"."published_by_user_id" is not null)

channel_connections_credential_secret_re.name: channel_connections_credential_secret_ref_check
channel_connections_credential_secret_re.value:
"channel_connections"."credential_secret_ref" is null
        or ("channel_connections"."credential_secret_ref" = btrim("channel_connections"."credential_secret_ref")
          and length("channel_connections"."credential_secret_ref") between 6 and 512
          and "channel_connections"."credential_secret_ref" ~ '^[a-z][a-z0-9+.-]{1,31}://[^[:space:]]+$')

faqs_effective_interval_check.name: faqs_effective_interval_check
faqs_effective_interval_check.value:
"faqs"."effective_to" is null
        or ("faqs"."effective_from" is not null and "faqs"."effective_to" > "faqs"."effective_from")

faqs_publication_check.name: faqs_publication_check
faqs_publication_check.value:
"faqs"."status" = 'draft'
        or ("faqs"."effective_from" is not null and "faqs"."published_by_user_id" is not null)

location_closures_interval_shape_check.name: location_closures_interval_shape_check
location_closures_interval_shape_check.value:
("location_closures"."kind" = 'closed'
          and "location_closures"."opens_at_local" is null
          and "location_closures"."closes_at_local" is null)
        or ("location_closures"."kind" = 'override'
          and "location_closures"."opens_at_local" is not null
          and "location_closures"."closes_at_local" is not null
          and "location_closures"."opens_at_local" < "location_closures"."closes_at_local")

location_versions_time_zone_check.name: location_versions_time_zone_check
location_versions_time_zone_check.value:
"location_versions"."time_zone" = btrim("location_versions"."time_zone")
        and length("location_versions"."time_zone") between 1 and 255
        and ("location_versions"."time_zone" = 'UTC' or "location_versions"."time_zone" ~ '^[A-Za-z_+-]+(?:/[A-Za-z0-9_+-]+)+$')
        and timezone("location_versions"."time_zone", timestamptz '2000-01-01 00:00:00+00') is not null

memberships_lifecycle_timestamps_check.name: memberships_lifecycle_timestamps_check
memberships_lifecycle_timestamps_check.value:
("memberships"."status" <> 'invited' or "memberships"."invited_at" is not null)
        and ("memberships"."status" <> 'active' or "memberships"."activated_at" is not null)
        and ("memberships"."status" <> 'revoked' or "memberships"."revoked_at" is not null)

organizations_default_time_zone_check.name: organizations_default_time_zone_check
organizations_default_time_zone_check.value:
"organizations"."default_time_zone" = btrim("organizations"."default_time_zone")
        and length("organizations"."default_time_zone") between 1 and 255
        and ("organizations"."default_time_zone" = 'UTC' or "organizations"."default_time_zone" ~ '^[A-Za-z_+-]+(?:/[A-Za-z0-9_+-]+)+$')
        and timezone("organizations"."default_time_zone", timestamptz '2000-01-01 00:00:00+00') is not null

retention_policies_publication_check.name: retention_policies_publication_check
retention_policies_publication_check.value:
"retention_policies"."status" = 'draft'
        or ("retention_policies"."effective_from" is not null
          and "retention_policies"."published_by_user_id" is not null
          and "retention_policies"."approved_by_user_id" is not null)

service_prices_amount_shape_check.name: service_prices_amount_shape_check
service_prices_amount_shape_check.value:
("service_prices"."price_type" = 'fixed'
          and "service_prices"."min_amount_minor" is not null
          and "service_prices"."max_amount_minor" = "service_prices"."min_amount_minor"
          and "service_prices"."min_amount_minor" >= 0)
        or ("service_prices"."price_type" = 'from'
          and "service_prices"."min_amount_minor" is not null
          and "service_prices"."min_amount_minor" >= 0
          and "service_prices"."max_amount_minor" is null)
        or ("service_prices"."price_type" = 'range'
          and "service_prices"."min_amount_minor" is not null
          and "service_prices"."max_amount_minor" is not null
          and "service_prices"."min_amount_minor" >= 0
          and "service_prices"."max_amount_minor" >= "service_prices"."min_amount_minor")
        or ("service_prices"."price_type" = 'quote_required'
          and "service_prices"."min_amount_minor" is null
          and "service_prices"."max_amount_minor" is null)

service_prices_effective_interval_check.name: service_prices_effective_interval_check
service_prices_effective_interval_check.value:
"service_prices"."effective_to" is null
        or ("service_prices"."effective_from" is not null and "service_prices"."effective_to" > "service_prices"."effective_from")

service_prices_publication_check.name: service_prices_publication_check
service_prices_publication_check.value:
"service_prices"."status" = 'draft'
        or ("service_prices"."effective_from" is not null and "service_prices"."published_by_user_id" is not null)

users_deleted_pii_check.name: users_deleted_pii_check
users_deleted_pii_check.value: "users"."status" <> 'deleted' or ("users"."email_ciphertext" is null and "users"."email_lookup_hash" is null and "users"."display_name_ciphertext" is null)

widget_allowed_origins_port_check.name: widget_allowed_origins_port_check
widget_allowed_origins_port_check.value: "widget_allowed_origins"."port" is null or ("widget_allowed_origins"."port" between 1 and 65535 and "widget_allowed_origins"."port" <> 443)

widget_sessions_revocation_check.name: widget_sessions_revocation_check
widget_sessions_revocation_check.value:
("widget_sessions"."status" = 'revoked'
          and "widget_sessions"."revoked_at" is not null
          and "widget_sessions"."revoked_at" >= "widget_sessions"."issued_at"
          and "widget_sessions"."revoked_at" < "widget_sessions"."expires_at")
        or ("widget_sessions"."status" <> 'revoked' and "widget_sessions"."revoked_at" is null)

widget_sessions_revocation_reason_check.name: widget_sessions_revocation_reason_check
widget_sessions_revocation_reason_check.value:
"widget_sessions"."revocation_reason" is null
        or ("widget_sessions"."status" = 'revoked'
          and "widget_sessions"."revocation_reason" = btrim("widget_sessions"."revocation_reason")
          and length("widget_sessions"."revocation_reason") between 1 and 500)
